items: For every valid invocation of shiftPitchLinear (positive width W and height H; output storage writable for H rows with pitch P elements per row and P >= W; source input readable for the logical W-by-H region; x + shiftX and y + shiftY representable in the integer coordinate arithmetic used for floor-modulo indexing), every logical output coordinate (x, y) with 0 <= x < W and 0 <= y < H must store at odata[y*P + x] the exact binary32 source input element located at logical row floor_mod(y + shiftY, H) and logical column floor_mod(x + shiftX, W). The stored value must be bit-for-bit identical to that selected source binary32 element; interpolation, texture filtering, normalized-coordinate floating-point rounding, scaling, or numeric conversion must not alter the value.

The only caller-visible output behavior under review is the values stored at the logical output coordinates (0 <= x < W, 0 <= y < H). Padding columns at x >= W are outside the specified output behavior. Preserving the cudaTextureObject_t handle, CUDA normalized-coordinate rounding, texture filtering, timing, or any other implementation mechanism is not required; any implementation that produces the specified output values satisfies the dimension.

floor_mod(k, n) for positive n is the mathematical floor modulo: the unique integer r with 0 <= r < n and r ≡ k (mod n), computed as r = k - n*floor(k/n) in integer arithmetic. Therefore shifted row and column indices wrap periodically into [0, H-1] and [0, W-1], including for negative, zero, and positive shifted coordinates; clamping or zero-filling is not allowed.
